rationale: Marketing and competitive intelligence professionals perform manual site: searches daily because Google Alerts severely under-reports new indexed competitor pages (50 new URLs/week via manual search vs. near-zero via Alerts). Enterprise alternatives (Ahrefs Alerts at $99–$399/mo, SEMrush at $119–$449/mo) confirm clear willingness to pay, while the documented gap leaves a $20–50/mo price point unserved. Five or more distinct pain sources corroborate this across SEO communities, Stack Exchange, Reddit, and competitor pricing pages.
